title: A tidier edge for a commercial property.
intro: Bush trimming, weeding, edging and mulch work around a brick commercial building. These two finished-work photos show the existing bushes and planting beds Angel Tree Services cared for.

photos.caption: Trimmed bushes and mulched planting beds around the corner of the brick building.
A closer look at the existing bushes after trimming, with weeded, edged and mulched beds beside the walkway.
